 AI Summary Shortlisted candidates must prepare original certificates for age, education, and reservation claims ahead of the upcoming personality tests in New Delhi. Find out when the final interview schedule will be officially released.
 + Follow on Google Add as preferred source The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the results of the civil services (main) examination 2026. The successful candidates qualify for the personality test.
 The main examination was conducted from August 21 to 30.
 The civil services examination is conducted annually in three stages — preliminary, main, and interview.
 Successful candidates will be required to produce original certificates supporting their eligibility and reservation claims, including those related to age, educational qualifications, community, economically weaker section (EWS) and Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), along with other documents such as the TA form.
 The dates of the personality tests will be announced in due course. The interviews will be held at the UPSC office at Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi, the statement said.
 How to check UPSC CSE Mains result 2026 
 Candidates can follow these steps to check their results: 
 Visit the official UPSC website at upsc.gov.in.
 Click on the 'What's New' section or go to the written results page.
 Look for the link titled 'Civil Services (Main) Examination, 2026'.
 Click on the result PDF to open the list of shortlisted candidates.
 Search for your roll number or name.
 Download the PDF for future reference.
 Candidates can also access the official UPSC result notification here.
 Those who clear the written examination will proceed to the Personality Test, commonly known as the UPSC interview. The interview carries 275 marks, while the written Mains examination carries 1,750 marks. The final merit list will be prepared using the combined scores of both stages.
